name: Amchur
description: Unripe mango dried and ground — sourness without any liquid.

tcm.note: Follows green mango; no Chinese entry.

ayurveda.note: Amla-rasa and ushna, like the unripe fruit it is made from.

unani.note: Garam and drying, though the fresh green mango is read the other way.

histamine.note: Concentrated sour fruit — the same flag as green mango, more so for being dried.
